integrity: The point counts are exact exhaustive finite-field computations repeated by two coordinate systems. The genus-nine functional equation converts nine finite checks to a proof for the entire zeta numerator; no experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The model, genus, automorphism group, and ramification are published; the new result is the exact numerator and induced isogeny factorization for this F2 form. No polarized-isomorphism or general-family formula is claimed. Unindexed equivalent earlier computations remain a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Hasse–Weil numerator and Jacobian isogeny factors of a genus-nine Artin–Schreier curve
